_readme: Cross-language fixed vectors for the Noise rekey ratchet, read by backend/internal/noise/noise_test.go and frontend/src/lib/noise.test.ts. The ratchet mixes fresh X25519 and optional post-quantum secrets into the current key: ck1 = HKDF(k, dhSecret); k' = HKDF(ck1, pqSecret)[0:32]. A missing pqSecretHex selects the classic empty second input. One warmup encryption advances the nonce, which the rekey resets. The plaintext encrypted under the derived key must produce expectedCiphertextHex on both sides.
